HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.
   B. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Basic Prayers has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
   D. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily
